maddeler.e:
سررت (form I)
# سَرَرْتُ (sarartu) /sa.rar.tu/: first-person singular past active of سَرَّ (sarra)
# سَرَرْتَ (sararta) /sa.rar.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of سَرَّ (sarra)
# سَرَرْتِ (sararti) /sa.rar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of سَرَّ (sarra)
# سُرِرْتُ (surirtu) /su.rir.tu/: first-person singular past passive of سَرَّ (sarra) and سُرَّ (surra)
# سُرِ
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
